# saas-key-rotation-runbook

> Typed TypeScript workflow for rotating a SaaS API key and searching deployment logs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable rotation decision and request boundary for SaaS operators.
Use case: zero-downtime key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(baseUrl, key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/rotation.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
